top_categories.workout_context: GFNY Maryland Cambridge's mixed terrain rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
At mile 60 of 92, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
Race-pace efforts that mimic GFNY Maryland Cambridge's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before October.
When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of GFNY Maryland Cambridge. Train it until it feels boring.

Road-specific control matters at GFNY Maryland Cambridge. Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 92 miles.
At GFNY Maryland Cambridge, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 92 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what GFNY Maryland Cambridge's mixed terrain actually does to you.
2-minute all-out efforts on mixed terrain. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at GFNY Maryland Cambridge. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 92 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.

race_overlay.weather: October in Cambridge, Maryland, USA. Rehearse adaptable layers and race-day kit changes in the final 2 weeks before GFNY Maryland Cambridge. Use the organizer's current forecast and safety instructions for final choices.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for GFNY Maryland Cambridge’s 92 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Durability, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 92 miles of mixed terrain in Cambridge, Maryland, USA.
